settings.subtitle: Your Weekdot calendar in Homey.
settings.stale: Weekdot has not sent an update for a while. Open Weekdot on your iPhone to update.
settings.step1: Install Weekdot on your iPhone, iPad or Mac.
settings.step2: In Weekdot, open Settings › Homey and sign in with your Homey account.
settings.step3: Choose this Homey. Weekdot then sends your events of the coming 8 days.
settings.privacy: Your events are only stored on this Homey.

widget.not_linked: Open Weekdot on your iPhone and link your Homey under Settings › Homey.
